reviews.text: Hi, I came across your business and noticed you're doing great! Just wondering — have you ever considered having a simple, modern website for your clients to find you more easily online? I'd be happy to share some ideas if you're interested. All the best!

When you think “responsive,” are you thinking hours? 1-2 days? Try minutes! I discovered last night that our gas water heater was dead. It is now less than 24 hours later and we have a brand new water heater and are minutes away from a hot shower. Kind, professional, super-tidy, communicative, and dependable—just like you dreamed a plumber would be. Thanks Thomas, Raymond, and Mary!!!!!

I called for help a couple of times and Tom Sheffield came out and took care of the problem quick and did a great job. He is such a great and honest person and doesn’t give you the run around. If you want the job done right and you don’t want to be over charged for everything contact Sheffield Plumbing in Oak Cliff, they will definitely get your toilet/pipes or whatever your problem they will fix it and will get it working again.
Thomas has helped us with multiple repairs in our 100 year old house. One of my favorite contractors I’ve ever worked with.

Sheffield Plumbing is AWESOME! They are a small, family-owned business in the Dallas area. Thomas and Raul are great to work with. They fixed up my much needed sink and water heater repairs for our house we are in the process of selling. Don't hesitate to call them. They do fantastic work and are good, honest people that you can trust to get things fixed right the first time!

Thank you Sheffield Plumbing for everything!

Thomas was amazing.  He returned my call quickly and had everything fixed same day.  I rarely do a review but he definitely deserved it.  Stop what you are doing and put his phone number in your contacts immediately.  Best Plumber I've ever worked with.

We have used Sheffield for years and the quality of their work has not diminished. Thomas and his associates are a credit to their profession. They are very knowledgeable and personable. Thomas replaced our shower heads with the most amazing and reasonably priced unit. I say thanks ever day.
They have also done some major repair work which required working in the crawl space of our 70 year old home. A real act of courage.

Looks like we just found our 'go-to' plumber! Our experience  with Elite Plumbing was flawless. Thomas showed up right on time and within an hour had our faucet install looking and working perfectly. We are so thrilled with the service and fair price that we will not hesitate to use Sheffield Plumbing Co again in the future.

Great Plumbing Company, been using them for 20 years.
Thank you Thomas for always coming through

Very professional services rendered at a time most needed. Plumbers were respectful of my house, e.g., they laid runners down so they would not track dirt into the house and they were also personable, caring as to my situation, and I felt comfortable with them while they were working inside and outside of my house.

I would highly recommend their company if you need good, hard working and reliable plumbers.

I have had them over to my house twice to do repairs.  All were done quickly and efficiently.  Everyone has been extremely professional as well.  I actually live far way, and I pay extra to have them drive to come to my house, and it's well worth it for a company you can trust!

I live at 615 S. Oak Cliff Blvd.  I called for multiple plumbing repairs.  Thomas came out, gave me a bid, and stuck to his word - even though the repairs should have been more money.  I will always call them.  They fixed everything, perfectly.  Roy D.
Great job done. I know owner and his family since he was very young. Good affordable prices. I definitely recommend Sheffield Plumbing
I called on Friday morning to fix an outdoor faucet. And Thomas was there by 2:45. He gave me options and was done by 5 pm. Very good experience!
They have serviced the park where I work for many years. I only met them late last year and they are knowledgeable, yet reasonably priced. Definitely will continue using them.
Sheffield Plumbing has been my main plumber for years.  Responsive, honest, and reliable.
My experience is they never called me back therefore there will be no future experiences with  Sheffield Plumbing
Excellent service and exceptional customer service. Best plumbing service in Oakcliff.
Thomas was so helpful and made our repair quick and easy!
I just don' think they are affordable , very expensive for what they do . Don't buy the warranty . It doesn't cover anything like I was told . 100 extra for nothing
There is NO ONE BETTER than these people. THEY ARE THE BEST IN DFW!!!!
My family has used this company for generations. Most trusted, highest quality.
They have been my plumber for over 20 years I wouldn't think of calling anybody else
Did a great job replacing our water heater.
Great service and affordable.
Quick and reliable service.
Responsive, thorough and reliable.
